# Linux caption buttons separate GTK hit regions from icon painting

Linux caption-button boxes define size, side spacing and end spacing. Each action supplies its GTK position; the outer button uses that position for order and end padding and remains a window-drag region. Icon children own theme painting and the focus-visible outline. Shared root-state selectors choose maximize versus restore and hide custom controls when customtitlebar is absent. The owned patch used fixed Breeze18px/3px values; accepted0b93 instead scales Breeze size to the font and uses the renamed toolbox-background-color/text-color family. Check declarations and consumers together when changing this component. This is scoped CSS/source evidence, not a general naming rule or a verified Linux rendering result.

Scope: mail/themes/linux/mail.
